class.name: ResourceHandle
class.brief_description: Track the loading state of a single resource.
class.description: A ResourceHandle represents a single resource path. It tracks the loading state (unloaded, loading, loaded, failed) and emits signals when the resource becomes available. Get handles from [method ResourceManager.get_handle], or use the convenience methods on [Context].

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the resource path this handle tracks.

method.name: get_resource
method.description: Returns the loaded resource, or [code]null[/code] if not yet loaded or failed.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the current loading state. See the [enum State] constants.

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the resource has been successfully loaded.

method.name: load_sync
method.description: Synchronously loads the resource now. No-op if already loaded.

signal.name: failed
signal.description: Emitted when loading fails. [param path] is the resource path.

signal.name: loaded
signal.description: Emitted when loading succeeds. [param resource] is the loaded resource.
